appTag: Footsteps of Jesus · A journey through the four Gospels
metaDesc: Walk the life of Jesus through the four Gospels, place by place and in order — with a map, paintings, narration, his words and quizzes.
home: The Way — back to the start
mapAria: The routes Jesus travelled on a map of Galilee, Samaria and Judea
wordsIntro: The words of Jesus recorded in the four Gospels, gathered in the order of the journey. Every saying is a fresh rendering of the original meaning in today's language.
wordsSearch: Search his words — e.g. love, bread, peace
harmonyIntro: See at a glance where each of the four Gospels records every scene — four witnesses telling the same story through different eyes.
quizIntro: Answer questions period by period and collect footstep stamps. Correct answers are saved on this device.
stampsNote: Opening a scene leaves a footstep; a correct quiz answer earns a star. Your record is kept only in this browser.
resetConfirm: Clear all your footsteps and quiz results?
loadError: The journey data could not be loaded. Please refresh the page.
wordsNote: The sayings are fresh renderings of the original meaning in today's language. Text: {r}
noVoiceLang: This device has no English voice, so the text will follow at reading speed.
noVoice: This browser cannot read aloud, so the text will follow at reading speed.
journeyEnd: You have reached the end of the journey. Thank you for walking with us.
quizPerfect: Perfect! You have walked this way to the full.
quizGood: Well done. The way is taking root in your heart.
quizOk: That's all right. Walk the scenes again and take it slowly.
